name: Editor Physics
description: Real-time physics simulation inside the level editor

world-gravity.name: World Gravity
world-gravity.description: Controls gravity strength. Higher values make objects fall faster.

physics-refresh-rate.name: Physics Refresh Rate
physics-refresh-rate.description: Simulation steps per second. Note: This can impact performance.

friction.name: Friction
friction.description: Controls how much objects slide against each other. 0.0 is ice, higher values add more grip.

restitution.name: Bounciness
restitution.description: Controls how much objects bounce on impact.

linear-damping.name: Linear Damping
linear-damping.description: Air resistance. Controls how fast moving objects slow down over time.

angular-damping.name: Angular Damping
angular-damping.description: Rotational resistance. Controls how fast spinning objects stop rotating.

enable-editor-button.name: Enable Button
enable-editor-button.description: Show the Toggle Physics button in the editor.

editor-button-position.name: Button Position
editor-button-position.enable-if-description: Requires the button to be enabled

toggle-physics.name: Physics Toggle Key
toggle-physics.description: Key to toggle the physics simulation.
